dict.string: Polydance asks Arc for the addresses of its tabs, only while Arc is using the microphone, to tell a Google Meet call from anything else. It reads nothing else and changes nothing in Arc.

Polydance records the sound of your Google Meet call in Arc (and, for a walkthrough, your Mac's sound) so the other people's words are in the transcript. Music and other apps are left out of calls. Recordings stay on this Mac.
Polydance records your voice on its own track when it records a call or a walkthrough, so the transcript can tell your words from everyone else's. Recordings stay on this Mac.
